## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclicals/materials leading while many Big Tech names show short-term 1W/1M divergences, confirming rotation rather than a pure risk-off.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate lead: CCI RECOVERY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%). Materials lead: NEM RECOVERY (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) and FCX RECOVERY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%). Technology showing strength via INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) and AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM CORRECTION (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) and CVX CORRECTION (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%). Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) and GM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.49%). Communication has select weakness: TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NEM RECOVERY (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), FCX RECOVERY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%), CCI RECOVERY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%), BA RECOVERY (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/materials tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%), CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.58% | 1M: -15.38%), UL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%), SLB CORRECTION (1W: -5.49% | 1M: +3.24%), TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%). Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary, select Utilities and Energy names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%), INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%), CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%), BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%). Major divergence present (many large caps showing 1W up / 1M down) — tactical opportunities, not core-position signals; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%), while AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -7.83%) and NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) show short-term rebounds — Sector breadth: Technology: positive overall (24 stocks) and contributing to rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed but supportive: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) with pockets of weakness in card names — V BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) and MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%). Sector breadth: Financials: positive (20 stocks) and helping rotation into cyclicals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing selective strength on news-led names: LLY RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) on FDA approval news and PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%). Sector breadth: Healthcare: positive (17 stocks) with headline-driven movers.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals/materials exposure given rotation: FCX RECOVERY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%), BA RECOVERY (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%), CCI RECOVERY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%). Reduce exposure to structurally weak names in Consumer Discretionary and select defensives showing downside pressure (NKE BELOW TREND, UL BELOW TREND); style: Value/Cyclical tilt for now.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) on FDA catalyst. BEARISH: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%), SLB CORRECTION (1W: -5.49% | 1M: +3.24%), CVX CORRECTION (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (9/11 stocks contributing to gains) and Real Estate (strong 1W performers) as rotation beneficiaries; Technology to watch for follow-through. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.14% | 1M: +8.03%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) — signs of trend exhaustion and earnings/estimates risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) — need follow-through above recent 1W highs to validate strength. AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) — watch hold of weekly gains as an early sign of broader tech stabilization. JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) — reclaiming 1M highs would confirm financial-led rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+85): LLY RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) — FDA approval catalyst; short-term price action confirming the news-driven move. PLD (+80): PLD RECOVERY (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +2.50%) — beat-and-raise momentum appears confirming (monitor for follow-through). AVGO (+60): AVGO RECOVERY (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.00%) — large contract win; price action currently confirming analyst interest.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-70): PYPL CORRECTION (1W: -X% | 1M: -Y%) — CEO exit and lawsuit headline is a clear negative catalyst and should be watched for further downside (monitor). NKE (-50): NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) — price action confirms multiple downgrades and sentiment pressure. ASML (-60): ASML CORRECTION (1W: -X% | 1M: -Y%) — policy risk on chip exports is a clear headwind; watch order flow and guidance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical style tilt as breadth shows 9/11 sectors positive and cyclicals/materials leading. INTC ABOVE TREND, NEM RECOVERY and FCX RECOVERY are showing relative strength while many Big Tech names are short-term RECOVERYs. Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences across large caps and several headline-driven names (LLY, PYPL, NKE) require monitoring for trend confirmation.
